scenario: When Stripe sends its daily payout, the agent reads the charges, refunds, and fees in that payout and creates a matching bank deposit in QuickBooks, with fees booked as a separate expense line so the payout ties to the bank feed.
rule_hooks: fee GL account mapping, payout-to-deposit tie-out

scenario: When a Salesforce opportunity is marked Closed Won, the agent creates a draft invoice in Xero for the account, using the opportunity's line items, billing contact, and payment terms, and writes the Xero invoice number back to the opportunity.
rule_hooks: payment terms by customer tier, product-to-item mapping

scenario: When an invoice is fully paid in QuickBooks, the agent finds the linked HubSpot deal and updates its payment status, paid date, and amount collected, and flags partial payments in a deal property.
rule_hooks: partial vs full payment thresholds

scenario: When an expense report is approved in Expensify, the agent creates a vendor bill for the employee in NetSuite, with each expense line coded to its GL account and department, so the reimbursement goes out in the next payment run.
rule_hooks: expense category to GL mapping, department codes

scenario: When procurement adds a new approved vendor row to the Vendor Onboarding Google Sheet, the agent creates the vendor in Bill.com with remit-to address, payment terms, and 1099 flag, then marks the row as synced with the new vendor ID.
rule_hooks: 1099 eligibility by entity type, default terms

scenario: When a purchase order is approved in Coupa, the agent adds or updates a row in the AP Commitments Google Sheet with PO number, vendor, amount, cost center, and expected delivery date so budget owners see their open commitments.
rule_hooks: cost center ownership, commitment status values

scenario: When a Zendesk ticket tagged 'refund_approved' is solved, the agent creates a credit memo in QuickBooks against the customer's original invoice for the approved amount and posts the credit memo number as an internal note on the ticket.
rule_hooks: refund approval limits, original invoice lookup

scenario: After each Gusto payroll run is finalized, the agent reads the payroll summary and posts a summarized journal entry in Xero splitting wages, employer taxes, and benefits by department.
rule_hooks: payroll item to GL mapping, department allocation

scenario: When the FP&A team marks a department's tab in the FY Budget Google Sheet as 'Final', the agent loads the monthly budget amounts by GL account into the budget version in QuickBooks so budget-vs-actual reports use the approved numbers.
rule_hooks: approved budget version, account code mapping

scenario: Each night the agent pulls newly cleared Ramp card transactions with receipts and memos and creates matching expense entries in NetSuite, coded to the GL account, class, and location set on the card's spending policy.
rule_hooks: card policy to GL/class mapping, receipt required threshold

scenario: When a customer order form is fully signed in DocuSign, the agent reads the contract value, start date, and billing frequency and creates a recurring invoice schedule in Xero, plus a row in the Revenue Contracts sheet.
rule_hooks: billing frequency rules, contract start alignment

scenario: When an Intercom conversation tagged 'billing_update' records a customer's new billing address or tax ID, the agent updates the customer record in QuickBooks and the matching Salesforce account so future invoices carry the right details.
rule_hooks: tax ID format validation, source of truth precedence

scenario: When a capital purchase bill over the capitalization threshold is approved in QuickBooks, the agent adds the asset to the Fixed Asset Register Google Sheet with cost, in-service date, asset class, and useful life.
rule_hooks: capitalization threshold, asset class useful lives

scenario: When the US entity raises an intercompany invoice in NetSuite to the UK subsidiary, the agent creates the mirror vendor bill in the UK entity's Xero with the same reference, amount converted at the month's agreed rate, and intercompany GL codes.
rule_hooks: intercompany FX rate table, IC account mapping

scenario: On the first business day of each month, the agent reads the treasury team's FX Rates Google Sheet and updates the period exchange rates for each currency pair in NetSuite, logging any rate that moved more than 5% to #treasury in Slack.
rule_hooks: month-end rate policy, variance alert threshold

scenario: When a HubSpot company moves to lifecycle stage 'Customer', the agent creates or updates the matching customer in Xero with legal name, billing email, currency, and credit limit, avoiding duplicates by matching on domain and tax ID.
rule_hooks: duplicate matching keys, credit limit by segment

scenario: Each morning the agent reads overdue invoices from QuickBooks AR aging and updates the 'Collections Status' and 'Days Past Due' fields on the matching Salesforce accounts so account managers see payment risk before renewal calls.
rule_hooks: aging buckets, dunning stage definitions

scenario: When a collections reminder email is sent from Gmail for an overdue invoice, the agent logs it on the customer's open Freshdesk billing ticket (or creates one) with invoice number, amount due, and dunning stage.
rule_hooks: dunning stage sequence, ticket ownership

scenario: When the tax team updates the Sales Tax Rates Google Sheet for a new quarter, the agent updates the matching tax rate records in Chargebee and QuickBooks for each state and locality so invoices carry the new rates on the effective date.
rule_hooks: nexus states, effective dates

scenario: When a vendor's W-9 arrives in the AP Gmail inbox, the agent reads the TIN, legal name, and tax classification from the form and updates the vendor in Bill.com and the 1099 Tracking sheet, flagging mismatches with the existing name on file.
rule_hooks: 1099 classification rules, name/TIN match

scenario: When the Sales Comp Google Sheet for the month is marked approved by the controller, the agent adds each rep's commission amount as a one-time earning on the next Gusto payroll and updates the accrual row with the payroll date.
rule_hooks: commission plan rates, approval status

scenario: Each day the agent reads unmatched bank feed transactions in Xero older than three days and adds or updates them in the Reconciliation Exceptions Google Sheet with amount, date, description, and assigned accountant.
rule_hooks: aging threshold, account ownership roster

scenario: When an annual prepaid invoice is posted in QuickBooks, the agent adds a row to the Deferred Revenue Schedule sheet with the service period and monthly recognition amounts, and sets up the matching recurring monthly journal entry.
rule_hooks: revenue recognition period, deferred revenue accounts

scenario: When a subscription is created, upgraded, or cancelled in Chargebee, the agent updates the ARR, plan, and renewal date fields on the matching Salesforce account and records the change in the ARR Movements sheet.
rule_hooks: ARR calculation, expansion vs contraction classification

scenario: At month end the agent reads Navan trips booked but not yet billed and adds accrual lines to the Month-End Accruals Google Sheet by department and GL account so the controller can post the accrual entry.
rule_hooks: accrual cutoff date, travel GL mapping

scenario: When external auditors share their PBC (prepared-by-client) request list as a Google Sheet, the agent creates one Asana task per request, assigned to the owner listed, with due date and reference number, and keeps the sheet's status column in step with task completion.
rule_hooks: request owner mapping, audit due dates

scenario: When a vendor bank-detail change is confirmed through the callback verification form, the agent updates the vendor's remittance bank details in Bill.com and records the change, verifier, and callback date in the Vendor Master Change Log sheet.
rule_hooks: callback verification requirement, dual approval

scenario: When a wire or ACH deposit shows in the Mercury bank account referencing an invoice number, the agent records the payment against that open invoice in QuickBooks and posts any short-payment or overpayment amount to the customer's account as an unapplied credit or balance due.
rule_hooks: remittance matching, short-pay tolerance

scenario: When expenses tagged with a grant code are posted in QuickBooks, the agent adds them to the Grant Spend Tracker sheet under the right budget category and updates the remaining balance for each grant.
rule_hooks: allowable cost categories, grant budget caps

scenario: When a role in the Headcount Plan Google Sheet is approved by finance, the agent creates the requisition in Greenhouse with budgeted salary band, cost center, and target start date, and writes the requisition ID back to the sheet.
rule_hooks: approved salary bands, cost center codes

scenario: When a bill for an annual software subscription is coded to Prepaid Expenses in Xero, the agent adds it to the Prepaid Amortization sheet with service start/end dates and monthly amortization amount, and creates the recurring monthly journal.
rule_hooks: prepaid threshold, amortization period

scenario: When the tax team adds a new filing obligation to the Tax Filing Calendar sheet, the agent creates a Google Calendar event and a reminder Asana task for each due date, keeping them updated when the sheet's due date or owner changes.
rule_hooks: filing frequency by jurisdiction, owner assignment

scenario: When a customer replies to an invoice email in Gmail disputing a charge, the agent creates a Salesforce case linked to the account with invoice number and disputed amount, and marks the invoice as 'In Dispute' in QuickBooks to pause dunning.
rule_hooks: dispute reason codes, dunning hold rules

scenario: At the end of each week the agent reads the Petty Cash Log Google Sheet for each office and posts the reconciled transactions as expense entries in QuickBooks, coded by category and location, then marks the rows as posted.
rule_hooks: petty cash float limits, location class mapping

scenario: When the bank's monthly loan statement arrives in the treasury Gmail inbox, the agent reads the principal and interest split and posts the payment journal entry in NetSuite, then updates the Debt Schedule sheet with the new outstanding balance.
rule_hooks: loan amortization schedule, interest vs principal accounts

scenario: When a project milestone epic in Jira is moved to 'Customer Accepted', the agent creates the milestone invoice in Xero for the amount set in the Milestone Billing sheet and updates that sheet row with invoice number and date.
rule_hooks: milestone payment percentages, acceptance criteria

scenario: At month end the agent reads Zoom license assignments by user, maps each user to their department, and updates the Software Chargeback sheet with seat counts and cost per department, then posts the allocation journal in QuickBooks.
rule_hooks: per-seat cost, department allocation key

scenario: When a supplier emails a credit memo PDF to the AP inbox, the agent records the vendor credit in Bill.com against the original bill and applies it to the vendor's next open bill if one exists.
rule_hooks: credit application rules, original bill matching

scenario: When a budget reallocation request in the Budget Change Requests sheet is marked approved by the CFO, the agent updates the affected department budget amounts in Xero's budget manager and posts a summary to the department head's Slack channel.
rule_hooks: reallocation approval limits, budget line mapping

scenario: Each morning the agent reads the prior day's Square sales summary for each retail location and posts a daily sales journal in QuickBooks splitting gross sales, discounts, sales tax collected, tips, and card fees.
rule_hooks: location class mapping, sales tax liability accounts

scenario: When a freelancer submits an invoice through the contractor Airtable form, create a matching draft bill in Xero against the contractor's vendor record, coded to the engaging department, and mark the Airtable row as 'Entered in Xero' with the bill number.
rule_hooks: contractor rate card, department cost-center mapping

scenario: When the controller adds or deactivates expense GL accounts in NetSuite, mirror the change into Expensify's category list so employees can only code expenses to active accounts.
rule_hooks: account type filter, active/inactive flag

scenario: When a new department or cost center is created in BambooHR during a reorg, create the matching class in QuickBooks Online and add the code to the finance dimension mapping sheet.
rule_hooks: cost-center naming convention, parent-child hierarchy

scenario: Every Monday, pull open customer invoices and unpaid vendor bills from QuickBooks and update the 13-week cash forecast Google Sheet with expected inflows and outflows in the right week buckets.
rule_hooks: payment terms, historical days-to-pay by customer

scenario: In January, total calendar-year payments to each 1099-eligible vendor in QuickBooks and update the 1099 filing tracker sheet with amounts, box type, and whether a form is required.
rule_hooks: $600 reporting threshold, payment method exclusions (card payments)

scenario: After the monthly credit committee updates approved customer credit limits in the credit review sheet, write each new limit and risk tier to the Salesforce account and the NetSuite customer record.
rule_hooks: credit tier table, approval authority by limit size

scenario: When a customer emails a resale or exemption certificate to the billing inbox, mark the customer tax-exempt in Stripe Billing for the covered states, record the certificate expiry in the exemption tracker, and reply to confirm.
rule_hooks: certificate state coverage, expiration dates

scenario: When sales captures an EU customer's VAT number on the HubSpot company, copy it to the Xero contact and set the default tax rate to reverse charge for B2B customers outside the home country.
rule_hooks: VAT ID format by country, reverse-charge eligibility

scenario: After month-end close, pull departmental actuals from QuickBooks and fill the actuals column of each budget owner's tab in the budget-vs-actual Google Sheet, flagging lines over budget.
rule_hooks: GL-to-budget-line mapping, variance threshold percent

scenario: When a capital expenditure request is approved in Jira, create a project code in NetSuite for costs to accumulate against and add a row to the capex tracker with the approved amount and owner.
rule_hooks: capitalization threshold, asset class useful life

scenario: When an office or equipment lease envelope completes in DocuSign, add the lease to the ASC 842 lease schedule sheet with commencement date, term, monthly payment, and escalations, and create the vendor in QuickBooks if missing.
rule_hooks: short-term lease exemption, incremental borrowing rate table

scenario: For vendor contracts logged in the procurement sheet, create Google Calendar reminders for the AP lead and budget owner ahead of each auto-renewal notice deadline and update the sheet with the reminder date.
rule_hooks: notice period per contract, lead-time policy

scenario: When an employee is terminated in BambooHR, deactivate their Expensify account, flag any unsubmitted expenses or outstanding travel advances in the offboarding tracker, and notify their manager in Slack.
rule_hooks: final expense submission deadline, advance recovery policy

scenario: Monthly, aggregate Shopify sales revenue and order counts by ship-to state and update the economic nexus tracker sheet, marking states that have crossed a registration threshold.
rule_hooks: state economic nexus thresholds (revenue/transactions)

scenario: When a Stripe chargeback is opened or resolved, record the disputed amount and dispute fee in QuickBooks as a journal entry and update the chargeback log sheet with the outcome.
rule_hooks: dispute status lifecycle, fee reversal on win

scenario: When finance approves a change to a customer's payment terms on the Salesforce account, update the default terms on the NetSuite customer record and note the change on the terms approval log.
rule_hooks: allowed terms list, approval required above Net 45

scenario: When a purchase requisition submitted through the Slack request form is approved by the budget owner, create the corresponding purchase order in NetSuite with lines, vendor, and department, and post the PO number back in the Slack thread.
rule_hooks: approval matrix by amount, preferred vendor list

scenario: When the warehouse logs received quantities in the receiving sheet, update received quantities on the matching NetSuite PO lines and flag any receipts that over- or under-ship beyond tolerance.
rule_hooks: three-way match quantity tolerance

scenario: When a vendor emails a monthly account statement to the AP inbox, compare its invoice lines against open and paid bills in QuickBooks and log missing invoices or amount mismatches in the AP exceptions tracker.
rule_hooks: invoice number matching, amount tolerance

scenario: Each morning, read closing balances for every operating, payroll, and reserve account in Mercury and update the daily liquidity sheet by entity, highlighting accounts below their minimum buffer.
rule_hooks: minimum cash buffer per account/entity

scenario: When the controller marks auditor-proposed adjustments as accepted in the audit adjustments sheet, post them as journal entries in NetSuite to the prior-period close and record the JE number back on each row.
rule_hooks: materiality threshold, accepted vs. passed adjustments

scenario: At month end, read each customer's metered API usage from the product usage export sheet and add overage line items to their upcoming Chargebee invoice when usage exceeds plan allowance.
rule_hooks: tiered overage pricing, plan included quantities

scenario: At the end of each billing cycle, pull approved billable hours from Harvest for time-and-materials clients and create draft invoices in QuickBooks with hours per role at the contracted bill rates.
rule_hooks: client bill rate card, billable/non-billable flag, rate caps

scenario: Quarterly, compute royalties owed on licensed product sales from the sales report sheet and create a bill in Xero for each licensor, updating the royalty tracker with the period and amount.
rule_hooks: royalty rate per license agreement, minimum guarantees

scenario: At quarter end, compare each distributor's purchase volume in QuickBooks against their rebate tier and issue a credit note for the earned rebate, logging it on the rebate program sheet.
rule_hooks: tiered volume rebate schedule

scenario: When county property tax bills arrive in the AP Gmail inbox, create bills in QuickBooks for each parcel, split across the locations they cover, and add the due dates to the property tax tracker.
rule_hooks: parcel-to-location allocation, installment due dates

scenario: When the monthly health insurance carrier invoice arrives, reconcile its enrolled-employee lines against the BambooHR benefits census and enter the bill in QuickBooks allocated by department, logging mismatched enrollees for HR.
rule_hooks: enrollment census, employer contribution share

scenario: When revenue ops publishes approved price changes in the Salesforce price book, update the matching plan and add-on prices in Chargebee and record which existing subscriptions are grandfathered.
rule_hooks: grandfathering policy, effective date

scenario: When the AR manager approves invoices for write-off in the collections review sheet, apply bad-debt credit memos in QuickBooks against the invoices and set the Salesforce account status to 'Written off – credit hold'.
rule_hooks: write-off approval limits, days past due

scenario: When customers email remittance advices to the AR inbox, match the listed invoice numbers to unapplied payments in QuickBooks and apply the cash to the right invoices, flagging short payments.
rule_hooks: remittance reference matching, short-pay tolerance

scenario: Before each weekly payment run, review approved bills in QuickBooks with early-payment discount terms and add those still inside their discount window to the payment run sheet with the discounted amount.
rule_hooks: discount terms (e.g., 2/10 net 30), payment run cutoff

scenario: Weekly, compare each department's remaining monthly budget in the budget sheet with spend to date and adjust the department's Ramp spend program limits so cards cannot exceed what is left.
rule_hooks: remaining budget, minimum operating limit

scenario: At month end, read the stock-based compensation expense report from Carta and post a journal entry in NetSuite allocating the expense by department, attaching the report to the close folder.
rule_hooks: vesting schedule expense, employee-to-department mapping

scenario: When the warehouse submits cycle count results in the count sheet, post inventory adjustment entries in QuickBooks for variances and update item quantities, coding each to the right shrinkage or damage account.
rule_hooks: reason code to GL account, variance approval threshold

scenario: After each VAT period closes, pull the VAT return figures for each subsidiary from Xero and update the indirect tax filing tracker with output tax, input tax, net payable, and filing status.
rule_hooks: filing frequency per country, payment due date

scenario: When an invoice is issued in QuickBooks for a customer that requires portal submission, record it in the customer portal submission tracker with PO number and amount, and flag invoices missing a required PO.
rule_hooks: customer portal requirement list, mandatory PO reference

scenario: When an outgoing wire request in the treasury Jira queue gets its final approval, record the payment against the vendor bill in QuickBooks and update the wire log sheet with the confirmation reference.
rule_hooks: dual approval above threshold, callback verification status

scenario: After quarter close, pull EBITDA, total debt, and interest expense from QuickBooks and update the lender covenant compliance sheet, computing leverage and coverage ratios against required levels.
rule_hooks: covenant ratio thresholds, EBITDA add-back definitions

scenario: Daily, read gift cards sold and redeemed in Shopify and post the net change to the gift card liability account in QuickBooks, updating the gift card liability roll-forward sheet.
rule_hooks: breakage recognition policy, liability account

scenario: Quarterly, find issued checks in QuickBooks that remain uncashed past the review age and add them to the unclaimed property tracker with payee, state, and dormancy deadline, marking them for due-diligence letters.
rule_hooks: state dormancy periods, payee last-known address state
